sourceAnchors.message: Avoid catching RuntimeException in try-catch block
sourceAnchors.reason: SS321 management SDK declares checked Exception for operation encoding and ClientRequestor cleanup. Both exact Runtime/Error clauses immediately rethrow the same object; the following checked-only catalog preserves fatal graphs, restores IRQ and retains existing IOException normalization. NPE is never caught and treated as a normal result.

sourceAnchors.message: In J2EE, getClassLoader() might not work as expected.  Use Thread.currentThread().getContextClassLoader() instead.
sourceAnchors.reason: This whole pure JUnit fixture implements the explicit fixed vendor ClientSession or ClientMessage interface through a typed Proxy. The defining interface loader preserves SDK method identity. There is no application class discovery, arbitrary loader input, native type or J2EE deployment-context lookup.

sourceAnchors.message: Ensure that resources like this ClientSession object are closed after use
sourceAnchors.reason: The declared ClientSession is an in-memory JDK Proxy from this whole fixture; its handler rejects unanticipated methods and opens no connection, transport or OS resource. The Production contract borrows the supplied interface and must not close it. Calling close here would invoke an unintended provider method rather than release an owned resource; all handler counts and early-stop postconditions are asserted.

sourceAnchors.message: To be compliant to J2EE, a webapp should not use any thread.
sourceAnchors.reason: Independent JUnit owns one daemon worker solely to prove ThreadLocal budget isolation; actual provider/network operations are absent. BUG2767 adds two bounded ten-second joins with finally interrupt and an alive=false postcondition. Failure or a live worker cannot become a passing test, and no unbounded ExecutorService.close is used.

The same whole Test asserts failedStep+1 callbacks and their exact literal sequence. The ordinal is fixed fixture input from SS321 six-stage order, with no configurable business value or Production-derived expected constant; this disposition applies only to this exact hashed source line146.
